test_title: PYST 9: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Did the police find out who break into your store?
solution:
The erroneous segment is "**who break into**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the simple** past tense.**
 
• So we need to use the **past tense form **of the verb "break" which is "**broke**".
 
• **The phrasal verb** **'Break into:** ' to enter a building by force; to open a car, etc.
 
 
• ***Example***: *Somebody **broke into** his car and stole his tools and CDs.*
 
 
 
• *​*We can see that we have used the past form of break i.e** Broke into** in the above-given example.
 
• The meaning of the given sentence is that the speaker is asking whether the police found out who robbed their store.

**The correct sentence is:* ****Did the police find out who **broke **__into your store?*

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2.**
